sentences: SEBI's cyber security framework tells a broker to close a high severity finding within one week.
It never says one week from when.
A period with no starting point cannot produce a date, and no amount of confidence will change that.

beats.label: The workspace
sentences: This is RegOS Sentinel, signed in as one small size regulated entity.
The bell carries the real number of things waiting on a person, and the profile names the firm and every registration on file.

beats.label: Dashboard
sentences: The desk opens on four counted facts. Not one of them is an estimate.
Open decisions, deadlines computed, evidence still current, and checks run.
One decision is blocking, and the reason sits right beside it instead of three screens away.

beats.label: How it works
sentences: Before it asks for any trust, the product explains its own pipeline.
Fetch the SEBI source, read it, compare it against the firm's control, and record a decision.
And stop, wherever the source stops.

beats.label: The source
sentences: Every answer begins at the source itself.
The exact passage, the page it sits on, the question number, and a fingerprint of the document it was read from.
Nothing here is summarised, and nothing is invented.

beats.label: Live source check
sentences: A saved copy is only as good as the day it was saved.
So the fingerprint can be checked, live, against the page SEBI serves right now.
The result is a receipt, whichever way it goes.

beats.label: The gap
sentences: Now it reads that passage against the firm's own control.
The period is stated. The starting point is not.
So no due date is calculated. The clock stays blocked, and the gap goes in front of a person.

beats.label: A named decision
sentences: The decision belongs to a named officer, and the tool enforces the order it has to happen in.
It will not accept a reading until every section the answer depends on has been read and fingerprinted.
Then the officer's own reading is time stamped, before the draft interpretation is ever revealed.
That order is the difference between a judgement and a rubber stamp.

beats.label: What changes
sentences: With the clock start recorded, the deadline computes and the checks pass.
One broad three month control splits into the two rules the source actually described.
One week for missing patches, three months for everything else.

beats.label: The record
sentences: The whole thing downloads as a compliance build report.
The decision, the person who made it, the evidence behind it, and the check codes that tie all three together.
A regulator can recompute every one of them.

beats.label: AI assistants
sentences: Four assistants read the same corpus, each with exactly one job.
They follow a fixed sequence of steps, and every step is recorded and fingerprinted as it runs.
A tamper check then recalculates all of them, so an edited step cannot pass silently.

beats.label: What it will not do
sentences: Every check states what it may not do, in the same panel that states what it does.
It searches a pinned excerpt corpus. It does not browse the web.
It cannot resolve a pointer to a passage nobody has committed, and it says so rather than guessing.

beats.label: Ask RegOS
sentences: Ask it a question in plain English.
The answer comes back quoted from SEBI, with the locator attached.
Quoted exactly, never paraphrased, and never produced when the corpus does not contain it.

beats.label: Your own document
sentences: None of this is a fixed demo path. Point it at your own circular.
This is a live SEBI PDF, downloaded from their website minutes before this recording.
Seven pages read, fifty eight passages classified, and a deadline clarity score computed from that file alone.

beats.label: An honest empty result
sentences: Then it looks for the same deadline gap inside your document.
In this one, it does not find one, and it says exactly that.
There is nothing to decide here. A product that always finds something is a product that invents things.

beats.label: Full record
sentences: Everything lands in one ledger.
Who decided what, when, on which evidence, and under which fingerprint.
This is the artefact an inspection actually asks for.

beats.label: Worked cases
sentences: Four worked cases ship with the product.
Each one carries a cited source and an expected outcome, written down before it runs.
Including one that runs against a real SEBI advisory.

beats.label: A blank start
sentences: And it can be handed to a stranger. Restart, and the desk goes honestly blank.
No findings, no deadlines, no score, until a document is actually added.
RegOS Sentinel.
Decision support that shows its work.
And stops where the source stops.
